In 'modal.jsx', the 'ModalComponent' uses 'ReactModal' with 'onRequestClose' which might be triggered when clicking outside. The 'record-modal.jsx' contains the 'handleCancel' function which closes the modal. These elements need adjustments to prevent the modal from closing unexpectedly during drag operations.
1.bug_scenario: When a user drags the mouse outside a sound recording modal, the modal closes unexpectedly, causing potential loss of work.
